## Hypothesis

Running the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder and then conducting walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days will quantify the edge_capture and win rate impact of the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate, verifying its performance on the anchor days that define the OP-16 edge.

## Mechanism

Execute the Stage-1 backtest using the autoresearch grinder (which performs grid search and initial filtering) for the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate. Extract the top-performing parameter set from Stage-1, then run walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) testing and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29 SPY 710P, 5/01 SPY 721P, 5/04 SPY 721P winners; 5/05 SPY 722P, 5/06 SPY 730P, 5/07 SPY 734C/737C losers) to measure edge_capture (sum of engine_pnl on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine_loss on J losers)) and win rate impact.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Uses same position sizing as base engine (3 contracts for $1K paper account per risk-rules.md), adjusted for longer DTE premium to maintain 50% per-trade risk cap. For example, if 1DTE option premium is 2× 0DTE, contracts halve to keep dollar risk constant.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses 16 months of SPY options data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Overfit risk mitigated by holding out top 3 J days for OOS/real-fills. Sample size sufficient but walk-forward guards against selection bias.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will ensure J days are excluded from Stage-1 training set or treated as hold-out).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate using cached real OPRA data on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Single J day loss exceeding edge_capture threshold.
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive loser day losses increasing drawdown beyond tolerance.
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility gap causing catastrophic loss on a J day (e.g., 5/04 extreme vol).
   - Regime shift: DTE premium relationship changing, reducing longer DTE advantage.
6. **Concentration:** UNKNOWN -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backtest completes via autoresearch grinder without errors.
- Walk-forward OOS on top 3 J days shows edge_capture > 0 and win rate > 50% on winner days.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days yields P&L within ±20% of backtested P&L for those days.
- No anchor regression: engine takes all 3 winner days and skips/loses less on all 3 loser days per OP-16.
- Passes gym validators and any new tests for this validation.
